text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Mesin Cetak dan Penerbitan

(Kawalan Hasil Penerbitan Tidak Diingini) (No. 38) 2017.

Larangan

2. Pencetakan, pengimportan, penghasilan, penghasilan semula, penerbitan,

penjualan, pengeluaran, pengelilingan, pengedaran atau pemilikan hasil penerbitan yang

diperihalkan dalam Jadual yang mungkin memudaratkan ketenteraman awam, yang

mungkin menggemparkan fikiran orang ramai dan yang mungkin memudaratkan

kepentingan awam adalah dilarang secara mutlak di seluruh Malaysia.

PRINTING PRESSES AND PUBLICATIONS ACT 1984

PRINTING PRESSES AND PUBLICATIONS

(CONTROL OF UNDESIRABLE PUBLICATIONS) (NO. 38) ORDER 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 7(1) of the

Printing Presses and Publications Act 1984 [Act 301], the Minister makes the

following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Printing Presses and Publications

(Control of Undesirable Publications) (No. 38) Order 2017.

Prohibition

2. The printing, importation, production, reproduction, publishing, sale, issue,

circulation, distribution or possession of the publication described in the Schedule

which is likely to be prejudicial to public order, which is likely to alarm public opinion

and which is prejudicial to public interest is absolutely prohibited throughout Malaysia.
